name: Nagasaki

queries.query: Nagasaki City official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry Japan
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Nagasaki City’s public Nagasaki Map viewer, its reference lot-number map, Nagasaki Legal Affairs Bureau map-maintenance work, and the Ministry of Justice registry-map data catalog entry. No public first-party vector parcel API was identified.

queries.query: 地籍図 長崎市 GIS 公開 地番参考図 登記所備付地図データ
queries.result: Japanese first-party discovery identified the official 長崎市地図情報サービスサイト（ながさきマップ）, the city’s notice directing users to its 地番参考図, and the Ministry of Justice/Nagasaki Legal Affairs Bureau registry-map dataset. The current viewer exposes 地番参考図 as a raster theme; no bounded public parcel-geometry response was found.

registryEvidence.localCustodian: Nagasaki City is evidenced as the local publisher/custodian of the public Nagasaki Map and its 地番参考図 reference lot-number map; the Nagasaki Legal Affairs Bureau is the national registry-map custodian for official registry-map data.
registryEvidence.basis: The official city page states that Nagasaki Map publishes administrative information including 地番参考図. The current viewer JavaScript identifies the 地番参考図 layer as a raster theme with an EPSG:2443 viewer configuration. The official catalog identifies Nagasaki-city registry-office map data in map XML format, but no bounded anonymous geometry API was evidenced.

requests.outcome: Official Nagasaki City page returned HTML and states that Nagasaki Map provides urban-planning, road, 地番参考図, and public-facility information. It links to the current public viewer.

Official city asset-tax notice returned HTML. It states that counter service for 字図 ended on 2026-03-31 and directs users to Nagasaki Map’s 地番参考図 for location checking; it directs official map documents to the Legal Affairs Bureau.
Current public viewer landing page returned HTML. No login was attempted. The page loaded map.js and modules_index_min.js.

Current viewer JavaScript/configuration returned. It exposes apiUrl/gazetteerUrl at https://www.sonicweb-asp.jp/nagasakicity/api/, sonicEpsg 2443, the viewer extent, and a 地番参考図 theme named th_5 whose layer type is raster. No parcel vector layer, feature schema, or geometry endpoint was exposed in the configuration.
Anonymous direct request to the viewer-configured API root returned the site’s 404 HTML page. No credentials, tokens, or private fields were used.

Official Nagasaki Legal Affairs Bureau result documents a 2025–2026 registry map-making project in parts of Narutaki 2-chome, Katabuchi 2/3-chome, and Meotogawa-machi. This is custodian/project evidence, not a public geometry response.

Catalog mirror returned metadata for the official Ministry of Justice dataset titled 長崎市（長崎地方法務局）登記所備付地図データ. It describes downloadable map XML and lists 2025 and 2026 ZIP resources; the catalog reports each archive at roughly 318 MB. No bounded feature query or lightweight geometry service was identified, and the archive was not downloaded.

full polygon or multipolygon geometry if exposed

crs.coordinateOrderNote: Exact WUP point is recorded in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate transformation or shift was applied.

verifiedSample.result: No parcel polygon was retained. The public city viewer exposed only a raster reference-map layer, and the registry-map dataset was distributed as a large map-XML archive rather than a bounded anonymous geometry response.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Nagasaki City public Nagasaki Map reference lot-number map plus Ministry of Justice/Nagasaki Legal Affairs Bureau registry-map dataset.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The city’s public viewer and official registry-map dataset are evidenced, but no anonymous vector geometry response or citywide polygon coverage was verified.

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent adapter qualification remains required
scopeLimits: Exact WUP latitude/longitude [32.7750877010875, 129.865140801342] preserved; no coordinate shift applied.
No GeoJSON sample was retained because no safe native parcel identity plus full polygon geometry was returned through a bounded anonymous request.
The city’s 地番参考図 is explicitly a reference map and is not evidence of legal parcel-boundary geometry or ownership.
The Ministry of Justice catalog/archive is source evidence, not an executed parcel-geometry extraction; the large archive was not downloaded.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, personal, or unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS-verification bypass was used.
A raster-only viewer, API-root 404, or absent bounded geometry endpoint does not establish citywide cadastral absence.
remainingUncertainty: Nagasaki has an official public reference lot-number viewer and an official registry-office map dataset, but parcel geometry access, stable native parcel identifiers, XML schema details, citywide completeness, legal parcel semantics, update currency, and production suitability remain unverified.
